description: Source code for managing WebKit worker sessions and console messages within the Playwright project, including event handling for worker creation, message dispatching, termination, and console logging.

classes.name: WKWorkers
classes.description: Manages WebKit worker sessions, event listeners, and console message handling within a page context.

methods.name: setSession
methods.description: Sets up event listeners for worker creation, message dispatch, and termination, initializing worker sessions accordingly.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all worker sessions and associated page workers.

methods.name: initializeSession
methods.description: Enables worker-related features in a given session.

methods.name: _onConsoleMessage
methods.description: Handles console messages from workers, formatting and forwarding them to the page.
